name: Gabrielle Dennis
bio: Gabrielle Dennis is an American actress and comedian, known for her roles as Cass on The Big Door Prize, Brianna Harrelson on the series S.W.A.T., Tasha on The Upshaws, Tilda Johnson on the Marvel Comics-based series Luke Cage (2018), Pippy Rosewood on the medical drama series Rosewood, Janay on The Game, and Denise Roy on Blue Mountain State.
